text:
marta-hr-ops: Heads up — noticed a batch of interview invites created after yesterday's ATS field-mapping change are missing the interviewer prep link and prep packet attachment. Candidates still get the calendar invite but the prep resources aren't in the invite body.

chris-recruiting: How many panels? any common pattern (panel owners vs direct interviewer assignment)?

marta-hr-ops: ~27 panels so far. Common pattern: the interviewer was assigned via the custom `panel` field (not `interviewer_id`). If we reassign manually the prep link appears. Suspect mapping dropped a field.

lina-peopleops: Thanks for flagging. That mapping job touched the webhook payload shape. Can you paste a sample webhook payload where the prep_link is missing?

marta-hr-ops: Pasting one (sanitized):
```
{
  "candidate_id": "C-12345",
  "panel": ["alex@redwood.com"],
  "start_time": "2026-03-23T15:00:00Z",
  "invite_body": "Please join the interview",
  "prep_link": null,    // used to be a URL here
  "attachments": []
}
```

sam-eng: that null stands out. Our scheduler expects prep_link or a prep_attachment entry. If both null it skips adding the section. Was the mapping job supposed to map `panel.owner_prep_url` -> `prep_link`?

marta-hr-ops: Yes, mapping change was supposed to be additive but looks like an optional path got removed.

lina-peopleops: Short term mitigation: we can run a backfill that pulls `panel.owner_prep_url` from ATS export and PATCH the invites for upcoming interviews (next 72h). I'll coordinate but need a list of affected interview IDs.

chris-recruiting: I can generate that list from the ATS. Doing a query: panel_field_set=true AND start_time > now() AND prep_link IS NULL. Giving it to you in 10m.

recruitbot: [sched-sync-job] ERROR 2026-03-23T12:07:11Z scheduler.sync: failed to enrich invite (candidate=C-12345) reason=KeyError('panel.owner_prep_url')

sam-eng: OK, confirm root cause: mapping removed `panel.owner_prep_url` path. I can push a hotfix to restore the accessor in the mapping service; will need a quick rollback window. ETA 45m if no surprises.

marta-hr-ops: Thanks. Also flagging that a couple of interviewers pinged ops asking where their prep link went. Can we send a manual message template we can paste into invites for the interim?

lina-peopleops: Draft template: "Hi {interviewer}, the prep packet for this interview is here: {prep_link}. If you don't see it, please use this fallback: https://docs.redwood.com/interviewer-guides/{role}" Use shortlink to avoid long bodies.

chris-recruiting: Received list and sent to lina. Also adding note to candidate-facing team so we don't accidentally leak internal prep links.

sam-eng: Deploying mapping hotfix to staging now, will run the backfill script against staging ATS export first. If staging backfill looks good, rolling to prod after 2 approvals.

marta-hr-ops: Appreciate it. Please ping #people-ops when prod fixed so recruiters can confirm invites regenerated or we can run manual patches.

recruitbot: [deploy-bot] Started deployment 2026-03-23T13:02:00Z user=sam-eng env=prod change=set->mapping.hotfix

sam-eng: Prod deploy succeeded. Ran backfill for next 72h, patched 27 invites. Leaving a note in each invite and adding audit tag `prep-backfill-20260323`.

lina-peopleops: Confirmed 27 patched invites, prep links now visible. Sending a short FYI to interviewers and recruiters.

marta-hr-ops: Closing loop — thanks everyone. Can we add a small monitor that checks for invites created without prep_link for 7 days after deploy? Would like to catch regressions early.

sam-eng: Will add monitor and a PagerDuty rule for >5 missing-prep events per hour.

chris-recruiting: Thanks team :thumbsup:

marta-hr-ops: Thanks :heart:
